summary: The ansible.builtin.runas become plugin runs commands as another user on Windows via runas; it only works with winrm connections, ignores become_exe, and requires the Secondary Logon (seclogon) service.
questions: How do I become another user on a Windows host?
Why does runas become fail on my Windows host?
Does runas work over SSH connections?
Which service must be running for Windows runas?

answer_card.title: runas become plugin (Windows)
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.runas` lets your login user run tasks as another user on Windows.

- Implemented in the PowerShell module handler, so it only works with **winrm** connections.
- Ignores `become_exe` (it uses an API, not an executable).
- The **Secondary Logon (seclogon)** service must be running.
